name: Chaotic Attractor
description: Virtual predator following a Lorenz strange attractor trajectory. Never repeats its path. Produces continuous low-level flock distortion rather than a decisive split.

preyResponse.description: Flock undergoes continuous micro-distortions tracing the butterfly shape of the attractor's influence region. The flock never achieves full coherence while this predator is active — a sustained phase below the critical transition point.

notes: The Lorenz attractor (σ=10, ρ=28, β=8/3) is the canonical example of a strange attractor with butterfly geometry. Using it as a predator path creates a system-within-a-system: the chaotic predator drives the near-critical flock through a sequence of micro-distortions that never repeat. This is a direct visual analog of the Vicsek phase transition being perpetually suppressed below the ordered phase.
